AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food Frying Frying? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food Frying Frying.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Soil Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
